description:
Generate HTTP clients from OpenAPI specifications for 11 frameworks:
Angular, React, TypeScript Fetch, Go net/http, Java Spring, Python httpx, C# HttpClient, Kotlin Ktor, Rust Reqwest, Swift URLSession, and Dart Dio.

Provide an inline OpenAPI spec (YAML/JSON) or a URL, choose a framework, and get fully typed, production-ready HTTP client code with models, services, and error handling.

angularOptions.description: Options for Angular framework (only when framework=angular)

serviceDecorator.description: Angular 22+: emit the standalone `@Service` decorator instead of `@Injectable`. AutoProvided = tree-shakable app-wide singleton; ComponentScoped = a new instance per component subtree. Auto-enables inject()-based DI and supersedes providedIn. Omit to keep the default @Injectable behavior.

useInterceptors.description: Generate slim services that delegate auth/error handling to HTTP interceptors instead of inlining them in each method.

dartDioOptions.description: Timeout overrides and OAuth2 refresh for Dart Dio

dioConnectTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Dio connect timeout in milliseconds. Zero disables the timeout.

dioReceiveTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Dio receive timeout in milliseconds. Zero disables the timeout.

dioSendTimeoutMilliseconds.description: Dio send timeout in milliseconds. Zero disables the timeout.

oauth2Refresh.description: Generate OAuth2 token refresh for the named security scheme.

documentation.description: Generate documentation comments in the target language

dryRun.description: Preview mode - returns generated code without writing files

errorHandling.description: Error handling configuration. Unavailable for Dart Dio.

useImportMetaEnv.description: Use import.meta.env for base-URL access (Vite, SvelteKit) instead of process.env

useMiddleware.description: Emit middleware hooks (onRequest, onResponse, onError) in the generated client

framework.description: Target framework for HTTP client generation

goOptions.description: Options for Go net/http (moduleName and packageName required)

usePointersForOmittable.description: Use pointer fields for optional/nullable values so they can be distinguished from zero values during JSON serialization.

useValidateStructTags.description: Add `validate:` struct tags compatible with go-playground/validator from spec constraints (required, min, max, format).

includeTags.description: Only generate operations whose service tag matches one of these values (case-insensitive).

usePlugins.description: Wire cross-cutting concerns (auth, retries, timeouts, headers) via Ktor HttpClient plugins at install-time instead of inlining them in each call.

openApiSpec.description: Inline OpenAPI spec content (YAML or JSON). Either this or openApiSpecUrl is required.

openApiSpecUrl.description: URL to fetch the OpenAPI spec from. Either this or openApiSpec is required.

optionsObjectThreshold.description: Minimum parameters before grouping into an options object. Unavailable for Dart Dio.

outputPath.description: Output directory path where files will be written

skipExisting.description: Skip writing files that already exist

typeMappings.description: Override how spec types are emitted in code (e.g. {decimal: 'string'} to keep precision in JS). Keys are spec type names, values are target-language type names.

name: generate_openapi
title: Generate HTTP Client from OpenAPI
